text_block_list.name: Cheers
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOO!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
I-Incredible...!
Biwa Hayahide was amazing, but Narita Taishin... that was pure tenacity, seriously!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah... But doesn't she
look kind of pale...?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Ugh...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Haa, ngh... haa...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...As you... can see.
I'm not... doing well at all.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Haha... Look at me, what a pathetic sight.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Supporting her shoulders as she could barely stand,
I somehow managed to help her back to the waiting room...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Sorry. ...I caused you trouble.
choice_data_list: It's not a bother at all...!
It's not a bother at all...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: "No, normally speaking, that'd just be a nuisance."

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Seeing Hayahide and Ticket get stronger and stronger made me panic and push too hard, and I ended up wrecking your training schedule.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...And this is the pathetic result.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: "...Even someone like you must be disgusted, right? Thinking what a pathetic shrimp I am—"

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ~~gh, I know!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I know that! I know the folks at the academy acknowledge me, and I know there are people cheering for me in the crowd too!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
That you've... always, always
believed in my strength.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Deep down, I knew it all along!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
So... ngh, it's not that.
...It's about me.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Not believing in my strength either.
Refusing to accept that I'm just a short, pathetic,
twisted, hopeless nobody.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: All of it, every single part... makes up who I am!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...It was completely meaningless.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: If I can't even accept myself... then running just to gain other people's approval was completely pointless...!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Sorry. ...I'm just a bit tired.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Let me rest... for a bit.
From races... and training...
